county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children were not informed in writing that the operation does not have liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment- Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §747.4403(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a multiple occupancy  swing on the composite play structure.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §747.4607(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A swing set at the operation did not have a use zone of at least 12 feet to the front and back of the structure.

top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.
